manual.answer: the mechanism engages or it slips; on_match is the engagement
manual.probe_admissible: a charge is legal only while it separates two rules the evidence still permits, so no charge can be spent on a question already answered
manual.declaration_admissible: a naming is legal only for a rule the evidence still permits, and it ends the run either way
manual.reserve: a run is certifiable when some sequence of the charges it can still afford separates its surviving candidates down to one on every answer the mechanism could give
